From f6ab594672d4cba08540919a4e6be2e202b60007 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Junrui Luo <moonafterrain@outlook.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Oct 2025 00:29:04 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] scsi: aic94xx: fix use-after-free in device removal path

The asd_pci_remove() function fails to synchronize with pending tasklets
before freeing the asd_ha structure, leading to a potential
use-after-free vulnerability.

When a device removal is triggered (via hot-unplug or module unload),
race condition can occur.

The fix adds tasklet_kill() before freeing the asd_ha structure,
ensuring all scheduled tasklets complete before cleanup proceeds.

Reported-by: Yuhao Jiang <danisjiang@gmail.com>
Reported-by: Junrui Luo <moonafterrain@outlook.com>
Fixes: 2908d778ab3e ("[SCSI] aic94xx: new driver")
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Junrui Luo <moonafterrain@outlook.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/ME2PR01MB3156AB7DCACA206C845FC7E8AFFDA@ME2PR01MB3156.ausprd01.prod.outlook.com
Signed-off-by: Martin K. Petersen <martin.petersen@oracle.com>

diff --git a/drivers/scsi/aic94xx/aic94xx_init.c b/drivers/scsi/aic94xx/aic94xx_init.c
index adf3d9145606..95f3620059f7 100644
--- a/drivers/scsi/aic94xx/aic94xx_init.c
+++ b/drivers/scsi/aic94xx/aic94xx_init.c
@@ -882,6 +882,9 @@ static void asd_pci_remove(struct pci_dev *dev)
 
 	asd_disable_ints(asd_ha);
 
+	/* Ensure all scheduled tasklets complete before freeing resources */
+	tasklet_kill(&asd_ha->seq.dl_tasklet);
+
 	asd_remove_dev_attrs(asd_ha);
 
 	/* XXX more here as needed */
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of the Patch

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/scsi/aic94xx/aic94xx_init.c`**  
- **Location**: Inside the function `asd_pci_remove()`, after calling `asd_disable_ints(asd_ha)` and before invoking `asd_remove_dev_attrs(asd_ha)`.  
- **Change**: Added a call to `tasklet_kill(&asd_ha->seq.dl_tasklet)`.  
  This ensures that the pending tasklet (used for processing deferred events) completes before any subsequent resource cleanup, particularly before the `asd_ha` structure is freed.

### Relationship Between Modifications

The single change in this patch directly addresses a **use-after-free vulnerability** caused by a race condition during device removal. Previously, `asd_pci_remove()` disabled interrupts but did not wait for the completion of any scheduled tasklet (`dl_tasklet`) that might still be running or pending. If a tasklet attempted to access `asd_ha` after the structure was freed, a use-after-free would occur.  

By adding `tasklet_kill()` (which blocks until the tasklet finishes execution or cancels any pending execution), the driver guarantees that all tasklet activity involving `asd_ha` has terminated before deallocating memory. This synchronization closes the race window and prevents the vulnerability.  

**In short**: The modification ensures proper cleanup ordering by synchronizing with the asynchronous tasklet before freeing associated resources.
